items.question: Within how many days will this retailer credit your refund after checking an online or pick-up return?
items.fact: Refund credited within 4-15 days after return checked

items.question: What two things must you bring to a Splash or Centrepoint store when returning products in person?
items.gold: The products in their original shipping packaging and your invoice.
items.fact: In-store return requires original packaging and invoice
